title: Transformed in Translation: Two-Stage Structural Uncertainty in LLM-Based Scientific Autoformalization
abstract: arXiv:2609.14808v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scientific autoformalization turns verbal accounts into executable mathematics, but executable code does not settle which model has been constructed. We examine two sources of structural uncertainty: the formalizer that generates a response law, and the recurrence that turns that law into trajectories. In secondary analyses of an openly archived crossed experiment, we studied 320 response maps generated by two pinned language-model formalizers from five engineered cognitive accounts within one sparse quadratic grammar and 16 randomized blocks. With whole blocks held out, source-account identity was recovered at 78.8% accuracy (chance 20.0%) and formalizer identity at 96.3% (chance 50.0%; both p < 0.001). translated_title: 翻译中的变换：基于大语言模型的科学自动形式化中的两阶段结构不确定性
translated_abstract: 科学自动形式化将文字叙述转化为可执行的数学，但可执行的代码并不能确定所构建的究竟是哪个模型。我们考察了结构不确定性的两个来源：生成响应法则的形式化器，以及将该法则转化为轨迹的递归过程。在一项公开存档的交叉实验的二次分析中，我们研究了由两个固定设置的语言模型形式化器在单一稀疏二次语法和16个随机化区块内、从五个工程化认知叙述生成的320个响应映射。在整块留出的条件下，源叙述身份的恢复准确率为78.8%（随机水平为20.0%），形式化器身份的恢复准确率为96.3%（随机水平为50.0%；两者均p < 0.001）。程序规模是最强的单一特征族；一项预先设定的探索性比较发现，在规模之外，局部几何特征未能带来稳定的源叙述预测增益。在保持所有响应映射不变的情况下，我们随后评估了五个递归……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究揭示了基于大语言模型的科学自动形式化中的两阶段结构不确定性——即使生成了可执行代码，源叙述身份仍仅能以78.8%的准确率恢复，而形式化器身份识别准确率高达96.3%，且程序规模是最强的预测特征。
en_tdlr: This study reveals two-stage structural uncertainty in LLM-based scientific autoformalization—executable code alone does not determine which model was constructed, with source-account identity recoverable at only 78.8% accuracy while formalizer identity reaches 96.3%, identifying program size as the strongest predictive feature.
